summary: Iteration 12 — Task 6 (бонусы/акции), Task 7 (брутто/нетто), Task 8 (отчёты залы/акции/лояльность) and the restaurant switcher. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_loyalty_iter12.py: 32/33 pass — loyalty-group CRUD with GET-verified persistence + seeded 'Бонусный клуб' (bonus 5%), group delete clears client.loyalty_group_id, manager-only enforcement (PIN 2222 / 1111 -> 403 on POST/PUT/DELETE, read allowed), promotion CRUD + 404 on unknown PUT/DELETE, /promotions/active correctly excludes active=false / wrong weekday / expired date window, client bonus adjust (+50/-20.5 -> 29.5, two LoyaltyTransactions with correct balance_after, 404 unknown client, manager-only), /api/settings max_bonus_payment_percent round-trip (40 saved, receipt text fields untouched), pay+bonus redeem (capped to min(balance, max%, requested); 4.50 latte -> redeem 20 capped 2.25 at 50%, cashback 5% accrual, balance math exact; 999 requested with 1.0 balance -> 1.0 redeemed; negative redeem ignored), auto promotion apply (20% of 50 -> 10.00 in applied_promotions, total reduced), non-stackable stops after first promo, condition_items min_qty=3 blocks at qty 1 and applies at qty 3, InventoryItem.processing_loss POST+PUT persistence, Product.yield_g auto-compute (200 g fry with 25% loss -> 150.0; cost stays gross 2.0; manual yield 999 respected; method changed to cold(10%) -> 180.0), reports by-hall/promotions/loyalty shapes + manager-only + unauthenticated 403, POST /restaurants/switch/{rid} returns a working scoped JWT (auth/me + restaurants/current OK), 404 unknown, 403 for PIN roles. Full regression: 238 passed, 2 failed (1 = the new 404 gap below, 1 = pre-existing iter10 negative-stock probe). All 7 iteration-11 hardening probes now PASS (modifier price trust, min/max, unrelated modifier, phone lookup, missing 404s, selection_type) — those fixes are verified. 9 new hardening probes in test_loyalty_edge_iter12.py fail and pin real defects. Frontend verified end-to-end on the public URL: /admin/loyalty (all 3 tabs, group create/edit/delete, promo create with weekday chips + time window + auto-apply toggle, delete, max-bonus 45 saved and re-read after reload), /admin/clients (bonus column, ±бонус modal +5/-5 with live refresh, loyalty group select listing 'Бонусный клуб (кэшбэк 5%)'), /admin/reports new tabs Залы (2 rows, Итого 6099.74 ₽), Акции (per-promo применений/скидка/выручка/ROI), Лояльность (3 metric cards), POS checkout with client match + bonus block (доступно 99.04) and a real payment (backend charged 2.03 = 4.05 − 2.02 cap, cashback 0.10, balance 99.04 -> 97.12). Switcher correctly absent with 1 restaurant, zero console/page errors on every page. CRITICAL frontend defect found: the per-ingredient processing-method select in the Menu recipe editor writes the value into `amount` (Task 7 UI is unusable) — details below.

minor.issue: Unknown/foreign id returns 200 {'success': true} (delete_one deleted_count not checked) — should be 404 like DELETE /promotions. Same class of bug fixed for /clients in iter11.

promo_is_active() compares HH:MM strings, so an overnight window (time_from='22:00', time_to='02:00') is NEVER active — a night happy-hour promo silently never applies. Handle time_from > time_to as a wrap-around window.

No validation: result_value=-50 and result_value=200 are accepted (a negative discount_percent would INCREASE the order total at pay time; >100% would drive it to 0), result_type='bogus' accepted, weekdays=[99] accepted. Add field_validators (0<=result_value<=100 for discount_percent, result_type in enum, weekdays in 0..6).
type is not validated — type='bogus' stored; pay_order only accrues for type=='bonus', so such a group silently does nothing.
amount=-1000 on a 0-balance client stores bonus_balance=-1000 (no floor at 0, no 400). Negative balances then leak into /reports/loyalty outstanding_balance and the POS bonus block.

_to_grams() returns 0 for 'pcs' ingredients, so a pcs-only recipe yields yield_g=0.0, and a product with no recipe is stored with yield_g=0.0 — the UI then prints 'Выход блюда (нетто): 0 г'. Return null when no ingredient can be converted to grams instead of 0.

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL: updateIngredient(i, 'processing_method', value) has no branch for 'processing_method' and falls into the final else, which does `recipe[i] = {...recipe[i], amount: value}`. Selecting 'жар.' therefore (a) never stores processing_method and (b) overwrites the ingredient amount with the string 'fry' -> Number('fry') = NaN -> serialized as null -> PUT /api/products 422; the modal stays open and the amount field is blank. Reproduced on 'Классический бургер' (Говядина amount became empty, save never closed the modal). Task 7's per-ingredient processing method cannot be set from the UI at all.

There is no edit action for an existing inventory item (only del-inv-{id}); the processing_loss inputs live solely in the 'Новая позиция склада' modal. Existing/seeded items (Говядина, Сыр, Булочки…) can never get their брутто→нетто loss %, even though PUT /api/inventory/{id} supports it. processing_loss is also not shown anywhere in the list.

'К оплате' does not subtract the bonus redemption: with a 4.50 latte, 10% client discount and 20 typed into bonus-redeem-input the modal showed 'К оплате 4.05 ₽' while the backend charged 2.03 ₽. The cashier is shown a wrong amount due and gets no indication that the request was capped (50% of the bill = 2.02, not the 20 entered). Show the capped bonus and the resulting total (and clamp/hint the input using settings.max_bonus_payment_percent).

The receipt has no 'Списано бонусами' line: it printed Латте 4.50 / Скидка (10%) -0.45 / ИТОГО 2.03 ₽ — the arithmetic does not add up for the guest (4.50-0.45=4.05). Add the bonus redemption (and the accrued cashback / new balance) to the receipt template.

yield-display is rendered only when form.yield_g != null, so for products saved before Task 7 it is invisible; and for a product with no recipe it shows 'Выход блюда (нетто, авто): 0 г'. Hide it when there is no gram-convertible recipe.

integration_issues.issue: Because of the updateIngredient bug the whole брутто/нетто chain is unreachable from the UI (method never sent, PUT fails 422 with the modal stuck open and no visible inline error). Backend part works when called directly.

issues: Date range still uses native browser <input type="date"> pickers (08/20/2026 US format) instead of the shadcn calendar — inconsistent with the dark design system and with the Russian locale
Акции table lists several rows with the same name (one row per promotion_id, incl. deleted promos); consider merging by name or marking deleted promotions
Category/Цех/Ед. измерения/Тип выбора/Группа selects are native OS <select> elements inside the dark modals (pre-existing, raised in iter11)
bonus-redeem-input label only shows 'доступно 99.04'; the effective cap (max_bonus_payment_percent% of the bill) is not shown, so a cashier can type any number and see no feedback

action_items: CRITICAL: fix Menu.jsx updateIngredient — add an explicit branch for 'processing_method' (and generally set recipe[i][field] = value) so the method is stored and the amount is not overwritten with a string
Add an edit action for inventory items (reuse the item modal + PUT /api/inventory/{id}) so processing_loss can be set on existing stock; show loss % in the stock table

POS checkout: preview the capped bonus redemption in 'К оплате' and clamp/hint bonus-redeem-input with max_bonus_payment_percent; add a 'Списано бонусами' (and cashback/new balance) line to the receipt
Treat time_from > time_to as an overnight promo window in promo_is_active()
Return 404 from DELETE /api/loyalty-groups/{lid} when nothing was deleted
Validate PromotionReq (result_type enum, 0..100 result_value for discount_percent, weekdays 0..6) and LoyaltyGroupReq.type
Floor client bonus_balance at 0 in POST /clients/{cid}/bonus (or reject with 400)
Return yield_g = null (not 0.0) when no recipe ingredient can be converted to grams, and hide the yield line in that case
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2890 lines with loyalty, promotions, orders, warehouse and reports handlers in one module — the split into routers requested in iterations 10 and 11 is still not done

pay_order() now does promotions + manual discount + bonus cap + transactions + write-offs in one ~120-line handler with no transaction boundary: if the loyalty_transactions insert or the clients balance update fails after the order was closed, the balance and the order permanently disagree. Extract apply_promotions()/apply_bonus() helpers and update the client balance before/with the order close

The bonus cap is computed on the post-discount total while discount_percent is computed on subtotal; document/normalise the order of promo discount -> manual discount -> bonus so cashier previews can reproduce it (the POS currently cannot)
compute_yield_g() issues one db.inventory.find_one per ingredient on every product write; batch with $in
/reports/loyalty loads up to 50000 loyalty_transactions and filters dates in Python — filter created_at in the Mongo query (it is an ISO string, so a range query works)

GET /reports/promotions keys the aggregation on promotion_id but shows the denormalised name, so renamed/deleted promos produce duplicate-looking rows; also 'revenue' sums the whole order total per promo, which double-counts when promos stack

context_for_next_testing_agent: Task 6/7/8 regression lives in /app/backend/tests/test_loyalty_iter12.py (self-cleaning; opens a shift if needed; promo tests are time-aware and must create promos with auto_apply=False unless they intend to affect other orders — leftover auto-apply promos silently discount every subsequent pay test). /app/backend/tests/test_loyalty_edge_iter12.py intentionally FAILS 9 probes pinning open defects (overnight promo window, promo result_value/result_type/weekday validation, loyalty type validation, negative bonus balance, DELETE loyalty-group 404, yield_g=0 for pcs). Run serially with `-n 0` when mixing with test_pos_flow.py (pre-existing shift race). rca_of_the_issue: Menu processing-method bug: Menu.jsx updateIngredient(i, field, value) branches only on field==='inventory_id' and field==='unit'; every other field (including 'processing_method' and the intended 'amount') hits `recipe[i] = {...recipe[i], amount: value}`. Selecting a method therefore writes 'fry' into amount and drops processing_method; saveProduct() then sends amount: Number('fry') = NaN which JSON.stringify turns into null, so PUT /api/products returns 422 ('amount' must be a number), toast.error fires and setOpen(false) is never reached — hence the observed stuck modal with a blank amount field. Backend Task 7 logic itself is correct (verified via API: 200 g fry @25% loss -> yield_g 150.0, cost still gross 2.0). POS bonus preview issue: Pos.jsx computes 'К оплате' as subtotal − discount only and sends bonus_redeem_amount to the server, while pay_order caps it to min(requested, balance, max_bonus_payment_percent% of the post-discount total) — the two never agree, so the cashier-facing total and the printed receipt omit the redemption (order 4.05 -> charged 2.03).
